summary.text: Mackenzie Holdren is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Jourdan Deitz for a seat with no incumbent.
She won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Gregory Watt, 514 votes to 449.
